Dr. Rowe demonstrates a simple exercise to help relieve pain, aches, and muscle tightness in the outer leg and thigh.

This exercise requires no equipment, can be done at home, and may provide fast outer leg pain relief in just 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
